title: Finite-strip graded map is epi
statement: Let C be an abelian category and K an integer commuting double cochain complex with total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let r be natural and assume K.X i is zero for i<0 or r<=i. Let A be an integer cochain complex, b:A→Tot(K), and f_p:single(A.X p,0)→K.flip.X p for every integer p. Let F be a decreasing filtration of Cone(b) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], whose degree-n step p is the join of the source image when p<=n+1 and the target diagonal images indexed by 0<=i<r and p<=n-i. The canonical map [def-sc-finite-strip-cone-graded-map] from Cone(f_p)^(n-p) to gr_F^p Cone(b)^n is epic for all integer p,n. No augmentation or differential identification hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4 second-variable variant; explicit cone refinement of lem-sc-finite-strip-cone-filtration, step 3

proof.text: The image of the row inclusion and the next filtration step jointly generate the current step: each source or target generator either has vertical index exactly p and factors through the row inclusion, or has strictly greater vertical index and lies in the next step. Conversely, the row factors through the current step and the next step is contained in it.

Lift the row into the evaluated current subcomplex via the inverse of its image factor, which is an isomorphism because the evaluated step inclusion is mono. Evaluate the next-subcomplex inclusion and cokernel projection; their composite is zero and the projection is epi.

To prove the row-to-quotient composite epic, take an arrow z from the quotient annihilating it. Both the lifted row and the next-subcomplex inclusion factor through the kernel of q followed by z. The joint-image equality implies that the entire current step factors through that kernel. Cancel its monic inclusion to see q followed by z is zero, then cancel the epic q to get z zero. Apply Preadditive.epi_of_cancel_zero.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteStripGradedMap_epi
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (f : ∀ p : ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X p) ⟶ K.flip.X p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone b))
    (hsteps : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
      (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl b).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
      (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (r : ℤ)).sup (fun i ↦
        if p ≤ n - i then imageSubobject
          (K.ιTotalOrZero (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i (n - i) n ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr b).f n) else ⊥))
    (p n : ℤ) : Epi (finiteStripGradedMap K r hsupport A b f F hsteps p n)
